name: Kadavu Island
reason: Wikivoyage Kadavu page, fijiguide Kadavu chapter and Fodor's Kadavu Group name the island as a destination: Great Astrolabe Reef diving, waterfalls, birding, village visits (rules 1-2). Judged as a place worth going to.

name: Great Astrolabe Reef
reason: 2 counted sources, 2327 page views

name: Naiqoro Passage
reason: Wikivoyage names it (as Naigoro) as a headline dive site, marine reserve with entry fee; one counted source.

name: Soso Passage
reason: Wikivoyage names it for the largest underwater coral garden; one source, dive site.

name: Nacomoto Passage
reason: Wikivoyage names it for eagle rays and cabbage coral; one source.

name: Manta Reef (Buliya)
reason: Wikivoyage names Manta Reef for manta rays; snorkel/dive site.

name: Vunisea
reason: Frommer's says it is not a town: post office, school, infirmary, few shops. No visitor draw (rule 2).

name: Vunisea Airport
reason: Transport facility; no counted source (rule 2).

name: Namalata Bay
reason: Frommer's and Fiji Pocket Guide name the bay, almost cutting the island in two; coral gardens and turtle-calling village.

name: Namuana Waterfall
reason: Fiji Pocket Guide lists a 20 min trail to a hilltop viewpoint then Waikana Falls for a dip (guide source only; no second source).

name: Long Beach (Kadavu)
reason: Frommer's calls it the longest uninterrupted white-sand strip in Fiji; second-tier beach.

name: Matana Beach
reason: Frommer's names it a jewel on the north coast; second-tier beach.

name: One Mile Beach
reason: Fiji Pocket Guide: end of the 10 km coastal trail, a stunning cove.

name: Kavala Bay Waterfall
reason: Fiji Pocket Guide calls it a must-see (45 min climb to high fall with swimming hole) and Wikivoyage Kadavu names waterfalls as a draw; second-tier nature stop (rules 1-2).

name: Malawai Waterfall
reason: Fiji Pocket Guide: small waterfall on a 3.5 km walk from a resort; minor, one source (rule 3).

name: Naikorokoro Cascades
reason: Fiji Pocket Guide: hour walk to two cascades with 5 m and 10 m jumping spots.

name: Vatalutu Island
reason: Fiji Pocket Guide: island with a trail network, viewpoints and beaches; 2-3 hr hike or day circuit.

name: Kadavu Trail
reason: 110 km unmarked trail requiring a tour company to arrange; not a visitable spot (rule 2).

name: Nabukelevu
reason: Fodor's lists Nabukelevu (Mt Washington) as a sight and fijiguide describes the 805 m volcano dominating the west with a guided village-led climb; two counted sources (rules 1-2). Climb needs village/landowner permission.

name: Ono Island
reason: Wikivoyage names Ono as part of Kadavu; Frommer's mentions it inside the reef; manta snorkelling.

name: Galoa Island
reason: Only a mention as shelter for whalers; Wikivoyage lists as part of Kadavu, with no activity (rule 2).

name: Dravuni
reason: fijiguide names Dravuni for white-sand beaches and the cruise tender dock; NCL runs a 150 ft lookout hike. Case for: real visitor island, beaches, trails. Against: village island, mainly cruise-ship traffic, only fijiguide as a counted source.

name: Waisalima Beach
reason: Beach belongs to Waisalima Beach Resort; Wikivoyage lists it only under Sleep and no visitor source names a public beach to visit (rules 1-2). Waterfall near Waisalima village only has a Kupi page.

name: Beqa Island
reason: Obvious draw: Beqa Lagoon shark and reef diving plus Sawau firewalking villages; fijiguide Pacific Harbour & Beqa, Wikivoyage Pacific Harbour, Fiji tourism board firewalkers page (rules 1-2).

name: Shark Reef (Beqa Lagoon)
reason: Wikivoyage Pacific Harbour: shark dives in Beqa Lagoon, officially a marine park, one of the best known dives in Fiji.

name: Dakuibeqa
reason: Village; no counted source; not a public attraction (rule 1, 2).

name: Dakuni
reason: Village; no counted source (rule 1).

name: Raviravi Village
reason: Village visited only on tour by boat; no counted source (rule 1).

name: Beqa Firewalking Ceremony
reason: A scheduled performance for resort guests, not a permanent place a visitor can turn up at (rule 4); firewalking is covered by Beqa Island.

name: Yanuca
reason: No visitor source names it (rule 1).
